flowchart LR
    C["Customer"] -->|"request, reason"| RP["Returns portal"]
    RP -->|"eligibility check"| OMS["Order record OMS"]
    RP -->|"label"| CAR["Carrier"]
    CAR -->|"parcel and scans"| WMS["Warehouse WMS"]
    WMS -->|"received, inspected, disposition"| OMS
    WMS -->|"restocked units"| AVL["Availability service"]
    OMS -->|"refund with return id, via the platform"| PSP["The PSP"]
    OMS -->|"exchange order"| WMS
    OMS -->|"refund issued"| ERP["The ERP, credit note"]
    OMS -->|"status"| C

stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Requested
    Requested --> Open: approved, label issued
    Requested --> Declined: not eligible
    Open --> InTransit: carrier first scan
    InTransit --> Received: warehouse opens parcel
    Received --> Inspected: graded per item
    Inspected --> Restocked: resellable
    Inspected --> Processing: clean, repair, repack
    Inspected --> NotRestocked: discard or return to supplier
    Inspected --> Missing: expected item absent
    Restocked --> Settled: refund or exchange released
    Processing --> Settled: refund released, stock later
    NotRestocked --> Settled: refund or partial refund decided
    Missing --> Settled: refund withheld or partial
    Settled --> [*]
